text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"Believe-san, Light O-san.
This summer, I have to catch up to the two of you leading the way, even if it's just a little!"

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Would you lend me a hand for that sake?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...Well, I don't mind either way.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Lend you a chest?
It's physically impossible to tear it off my body.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
...I don't literally mean lend me money.
Listen, Light O...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"No loans needed! No jokes needed! Just match my pace!"
Will this get the message across?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"All I gotta do is run alongside you, right?
Got it."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: This sprint Umamusume trio always seemed to be like this.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The straightforward, uncompromising
Calstone Light O.
And Durandal, delivering merciless retorts.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And Believe watches over her.
Even during the training camp, that dynamic remains unchanged."

text_block_list.name: The Three
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Take the lead and hold on...!
If I can run it through without slowing down the lap times!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Not yet! At the very, very end, I'll cut them down in a flash of sharpness!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Winning or losing is secondary!
Today is purely about reaching top speed!

text_block_list.name: The Three
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To each their own philosophy.
And that doesn't just apply to racing...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
A crisp, refreshing flavor is essential for syrup.
Lemon is the only choice here.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: I'll... be leaving now.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Oh? Lemon for you too?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
No, the color is similar, but it's different.
This is called "amazura."

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: It's a traditional sweet that's been around forever, and my grandpa loved it...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
I see... That is so typical of Believe-san,
always cherishing her grandparents.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: I'll go—with this.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"What's... that? At first glance,
it doesn't look like anything's on it, but..."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Could it be like that fairy tale with the 'clothes invisible to fools'?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"No, it is syrup that is not just for fools,
but 'invisible to everyone.'"

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Because there's nothing on it.
Waiting for them to pour syrup is a waste of time.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even the shaved ice syrup they chose
reflected their personalities. Namely...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Durandal values 'sharpness', Believe values
'sustainability', and Calstone Light O
values 'top speed' above all else."

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I see. So Durandal is running in the Centaur Stakes,
but skipping the Sprinters Stakes, then.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Because there is zero chance of winning.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
It's not zero! It's just thin!
And watch your phrasing!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
However... looking at the long run,
I think that's for the best.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Taking on impossible challenges is simply not sustainable.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Yes, my King has a grand plan in mind.
Isn't that right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Calling it 'grand' might be an exaggeration, but she had definitely given it serious thought."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Challenging a sprint GⅠ relying solely on a late charge.
To pull that off, we still haven't accumulated enough experience.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: And so, this summer I think I shall take things at my own pace without rushing, partaking in "knight-worthy pastimes" and spending it true to myself.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Pray, join me, both of you. Trainer, what sort of amusement would befit a knight?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A knightly pastime suitable for summer.
The first thing that came to mind was...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"Holy Sword Watermelon Splitting, is it?
Thank you for the suggestion. Well then—"

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: With my magnificent swordplay, allow me to slice this watermelon clean in half for you.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Believe-san, are you ready?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Watermelon placed. Go ahead.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Heh, even blindfolded,
there is no possibility that my strike
would ever miss its mark.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Here I go! Watermelon, split in two!
HAAAAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (KA-BOOOOM!)

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
O-Oh? It shattered into pieces.
Why...?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Durandal. You are not as
splendid an Umamusume as you think.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
It's brute force, if anything.
A club suits her far better than a holy sword.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"A club?! As a knight, I cannot possibly
wield such a weapon!"

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
What just happened was some kind of mistake.
Next time, I'll slice it clean in two...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Haaaaaah!
Fourth Sword, Dionysus's Lightning Spear!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (KA-BOOOOM!)

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Blade of the Heavens, Holy Light of Morienne-Ange!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (KA-BOOOOM!)

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Flowing Flash! The Watermelon-Cleaving Sword!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (KA-BOOOOM!)

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Why!?
Why doesn't it work like the move's name?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Durandal, it's fine. Crushed watermelon
is still edible. It all ends up the same in your stomach anyway.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Uuuu...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: By smashing a massive pile of watermelons with sheer force, Durendal's arm strength seemed to have increased.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
A pillow-fight siege battle...
I see. As a knight, taking command of a siege is indeed of great importance.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Then it's settled. Tonight, let us divide into offense and defense,
and battle it out.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, night fell. Divided into Durandal's siege army
and Calstone Light O's defense army,
the pillow fight commenced.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Knights of Durandal, prepare to charge!
Do not falter!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Unleash the pillows! Prepare the battering ram!
Once the castle walls crumble, follow meee!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Like we'd let you! Everyone, intercept!
Fire the Light-Speed Pillow Launcher!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"No need to crash into the opponent!
Just go at maximum speed. Oooooh!"

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"Calstone-san!? Stop that!
What you're throwing isn't a pillow, it's the match!"

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Please, just make sure not to hit the sliding paper doors.
Tearing them... is a no-no.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Calstone Light O flying off the handle.
Through that back-and-forth, Durandal forged
the patience befitting a knight.
